title: Excise Tax Return for Automobiles and Non-Essential Goods

validation.how: Only the day and email labels can turn red (field() compares keys); the place, relief and manner rows never check errors; errors render via self.section("Needs review", issues, cx) after Part III, capped at 20.

findings.now: Clicking a month tile ignores that month, and the draft opens dated today, or 12/31 for an earlier year.
findings.why: new_draft drops the period argument, and new_from_profile(profile, year) takes the month and day only from today or December 31.

options.name: Pass the tile month
options.detail: Give new_from_profile the period and set Item 1 to it, as 2200-A does.

options.name: Lock after first save
options.detail: Once saved, change the month only by opening the matching tile.

findings.now: Any 2200-AN tile reopens the newest 2200-AN of the year, even when it is for another month and is queued or filed.
findings.why: load_draft scans every MMDD key and returns the latest row, so a monthly tile can never reach its own month, and a filed return blocks the next one.

options.name: Look up by tile month
options.detail: Find the draft for the tile's month first and create one only if none exists, as 2200-A's load_draft does.

options.name: Year list with New
options.detail: List this year's returns by month with a New action.

findings.now: The monthly 2200-AN tiles do not show a saved return as in progress.
findings.why: Drafts are saved under an open-ended key, which get_form_filing_progress counts as open-ended, while the registry lists 2200-AN as monthly.

options.name: Save under the month
options.detail: Key 2200-AN drafts by Monthly(month) for their Item 1 month, as 2200-A does.

options.name: Map open-ended rows
options.detail: Read each open-ended 2200-AN row into its month when building progress.

findings.now: Queue for submission is enabled for a complete return and then only reports that 2200-AN is not enabled in this build.
findings.why: The button checks only validation errors, while the registry turns queueing off for 2200-AN because no PROD SFTP folder exists.

options.name: Hide while queueing is off
options.detail: Render the button only when can_queue_for_submission is true.

options.name: Disabled with a reason
options.detail: Grey the button out with a line saying queueing is off for 2200-AN in this build.

findings.now: Each place level is a button labelled like 'Region: (select)' that opens a wrapped list of every option, with no search.
findings.why: Lists this long belong in a combobox, and the 2200-A page already uses a searchable select for the same codes.

options.name: Searchable select per level
options.detail: Use the searchable select that 2200-A uses for region, province and city.

options.name: Cascading combobox
options.detail: Enable province after region and city after province, as 2200-A does.

findings.now: Twelve small outline buttons set the month above the Day and Year boxes.
findings.why: Twelve options is past the button limit, and the official txtMonth is a dropdown, so a combobox matches both.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A searchable Jan to Dec list that matches the official dropdown.

options.name: Native select
options.detail: A plain select with the twelve months.

findings.now: Item 2 is pre-set to No, so the official alert 'Please select an option in item number 2.' can never appear.
findings.why: is_amended is a plain bool that defaults to false, so there is no unanswered state for rule 2200an-validate-010-amended to check.

options.name: Optional bool
options.detail: Store None until the filer picks Yes or No, as tax_relief already does.

options.name: Unselected radios
options.detail: Start with neither button selected and keep the official alert until a choice is made.

findings.now: Errors on Items 8 to 11, 12A and 15 leave their labels black, and place, relief and manner errors never turn anything red.
findings.why: field() compares keys that differ (taxpayer_name vs name, contact_number vs phone, tax_relief_specify vs relief, manner_other vs other), and render_place, the relief row and render_manner never check errors.

options.name: Matching keys
options.detail: Report each error under the input key so its label turns red.

options.name: Row-level state
options.detail: Give the place, relief and manner rows a red state when their rule fails.

findings.now: Every error is listed only in a Needs review section after Part III, capped at 20 lines.
findings.why: Queue for submission stays disabled while errors exist, and the reasons sit beneath the schedules.

options.name: Summary above Part I
options.detail: Show the error count and first messages beside the toolbar.

options.name: Jump links
options.detail: Make each Needs review line focus its field.

findings.now: The print preview shows the email in capitals and cuts it at 28 characters, the width of its printed comb.
findings.why: The frozen filler uppercases every writer-cell join, and txtEmail is one (html-frozen/2200an-2018/writer-cells.json:86, 28 slots), so the email breaks the rule that it is never upper-cased.

options.name: Print the email as typed
options.detail: Skip the uppercase for txtEmail in the filler, as the submit path already does.

options.name: Wider email cell
options.detail: Map the email to a cell that holds the full address instead of a 28-slot comb.

findings.now: The print preview leaves the Item 10 and 11 place names and the Item 12A tax-relief text blank.
findings.why: The sheet records the place combs as holding option codes, not printable text, and Item 12A as left blank (html-frozen/2200an-2018/writer-cells.json lines 1219 and 1243).

options.name: Print the names
options.detail: Write the region, province and city names into the place combs instead of their option codes.

options.name: Print 12A as text
options.detail: Map the relief text to the 12A comb, which the sheet guide currently leaves empty.

findings.now: The ATC for each Others row is typed freely, and a bad code shows up only later in Needs review.
findings.why: No code list is offered, while the rule is an XG prefix with up to six letters or digits, which a picker or input mask could enforce as the filer types.

options.name: Combobox of XG codes
options.detail: Offer the XG codes printed for the fixed rows, with free entry for others.

options.name: Input mask
options.detail: Fix the XG prefix and allow only letters and digits as the filer types.
